editionLabel: La Boîte de Jeu English edition
firstPlayerRule: Everyone plays at the same time; there is no starting player. Begin by drafting one card each from the seven-card hands.
clarifications: Players reveal their chosen cards together. Pass the remaining cards left in rounds 1 and 3, and right in rounds 2 and 4.
Planning is simultaneous. Each Production step is also simultaneous, following the printed resource sequence.
